name: Slag Pit
summary: The Slag Pit is an extensive subterranean mining excavation nestled inside the Cauldron of Searing Gorge. Overseen by ruthless Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers, these fiery tunnels are driven by forced labor under the shadow of Blackrock Mountain. Trespassers must contend not only with hostile dwarf overseers, but also ravenous incendosaurs prowling the lower levels.

sections.title: Subterranean Toil
sections.body: Carved into the depths of the Cauldron, the Slag Pit represents the grinding industrial engine of the Dark Iron dwarves in Searing Gorge. Day and night, enslaved workers are driven to extract rich ores and minerals under the lash of brutal overseers and taskmasters. The environment is harsh and suffocating, dominated by scorching heat, choking dust, and the clatter of iron picks. The Dark Irons maintain ruthless discipline over their excavation, violently repelling any outside interference with their supply lines to Blackrock Depths.

sections.title: Depths of the Pit
sections.body: Beyond the cruelty of the slavers, the physical tunnels themselves pose a deadly hazard to workers and intruders alike. In the lower reaches of the excavation, the earth breaks open into scorching caverns inhabited by incendosaurs—ferocious reptilian beasts native to the fiery underground. Despite the constant danger of being devoured by these subterranean predators, the Dark Iron masters continue to push their labor force deeper into the rock, entirely indifferent to the lives lost in the process.

faq.q: Where is the Slag Pit located?
aliases: how to get to slag pit
faq.answer: The Slag Pit is located deep within the Cauldron, the massive excavation crater dominating the center of Searing Gorge. Its tunnels branch directly beneath the surface mining works.
The mine is entirely operated by the Dark Iron clan. Dark Iron slavers and taskmasters patrol the shafts, enforcing brutal discipline and driving their captives to dig around the clock.

faq.q: Why do the slave workers attack intruders?
faq.answer: While the enslaved workers are not naturally aggressive toward outsiders, their fear of their Dark Iron masters runs deep. If a slaver or taskmaster is attacked nearby, the panicked laborers will rush to their overseer's defense to avoid severe punishment.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Slag Pit?
faq.answer: In addition to the Dark Iron dwarves and their slaves, the deepest reaches of the pit are infested with incendosaurs—aggressive, flame-scaled saurian predators that stalk the underground tunnels.

angles.text: The deep shafts of the Slag Pit cut straight into the mineral-rich belly of Searing Gorge, making it a lucrative—if exceptionally dangerous—source of high-grade ores.
For dwarves of Ironforge, witnessing the cruelty of the Dark Iron slavers in the Slag Pit serves as a stark reminder of the bitter divide between the clans.
